apps.name: Psybeam: AI Voice Translator
apps.description:
Psybeam is a real-time AI voice translator for travel. Hold a button, speak, and the person in front of you hears it spoken aloud in their language. Hold the other button while they answer, and you hear them in yours. No typing, no reading, no app on their phone.

It is a live speech-to-speech interpreter in your pocket: it detects what was said, translates it as you speak and speaks it back in a natural voice that follows the speaker. Order food, ask directions, check into a hostel, talk to a pharmacist or a taxi driver, face to face, in seconds.

WHY PSYBEAM
• Voice to voice, live. Not a text translator with a speaker button: the translation is spoken as it happens.
• One phone, one operator. You hold the phone and run both directions from two thumb buttons. The other person just listens, then speaks when it's their turn.
• The translation faces them. Your words, in their language, rotate to face the person across from you. Their reply stays upright for you.
• No account, no sign-up. It opens straight to talking.
• No subscription, no trial trap. Start with free minutes, then buy a minute pack only when you need more. Never a recurring charge.
• Your conversation stays on your device.

22 LANGUAGES, SPOKEN BOTH WAYS
English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, Russian, Polish, Turkish, Greek, Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Thai, Vietnamese, Indonesian, Finnish and Swedish. Any pair, either direction.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Pick your language and theirs, or let Psybeam suggest the local language from where you are as you cross a border.
2. Hold your button and speak. Release, and it says it aloud in their language.
3. Hold their button while they reply. You hear the answer in your language.
That's the whole app.

BUILT FOR TRAVEL
Markets, restaurants, hotel and hostel desks, taxis, pharmacies, train stations, asking a local for help. Any moment when you and someone else don't share a language. Works with Voice Isolation for noisy streets and cafés.

PRIVACY
Audio is streamed directly to our cloud translation provider only to translate it and is never routed through our servers. Your transcript never leaves your phone. You can withdraw cloud AI consent at any time in Settings.

iPhone, iOS 18 and later. Open it, hold a button, and have your first conversation across a language barrier in seconds.

apps.name: Pay Day: E-Invoice & Peppol

Pay Day is built for exactly this moment, on your iPhone, with no desktop software and no monthly bookkeeping suite.

FREE, AND GENUINELY GENEROUS

- Unlimited clients, your logo, and multi-currency with European Central Bank reference rates.
- A real EN 16931 VAT engine: standard rates, intra-community reverse charge, zero-rated and exempt lines — with a correct, properly rounded VAT breakdown on every document.
- Works fully offline. Bill from a job site, a train, anywhere.
- No account required to start. Open the app and you're invoicing.

PRO — REAL E-INVOICE COMPLIANCE, NOT JUST A PDF
- Factur-X / ZUGFeRD e-invoices: a single hybrid file that looks like a clean invoice to your client and carries embedded EN 16931 data a tax authority's system can read automatically. Independently validated as a valid PDF/A-3 with valid EN 16931 XML.
- Peppol delivery: send your invoice straight into your client's accounting system over the EU's official network — no email attachment, no portal logins.
- Recurring invoices: set it once, get paid every month.
- Your branding: logo, accent colour, and templates that look like your business, not a template.
- Live VAT validation: check every client's VAT ID against the EU VIES service before you issue.

CREDIT PACKS — PAY ONLY FOR WHAT YOU SEND
- Top up with consumable credit packs that cover each Peppol network send (we pass through the real per-send cost rather than padding a subscription).
- The same credits power optional AI helpers: snap a photo of a quote or receipt and turn it into line items, type a rough description and let it draft the lines, or generate a tactful payment-reminder email for an overdue invoice. AI actions cost a few credits each and are entirely optional — the app is complete without them.

WHO IT'S FOR
Freelancers, consultants, designers, developers, and small businesses across the EU who invoice other businesses and need to be ready for e-invoicing mandates — without paying for a heavyweight accounting platform.

HONEST PROMISE
The free app is a complete invoicing tool, not a trial. We only ask you to pay where it genuinely costs us or genuinely earns you compliance: structured e-invoices, network delivery, automation, and AI. No fake urgency, no nagging, no surprise limits.

Pay Day Pro is an auto-renewing subscription, monthly or annual with a 7-day free trial. Peppol network sends are metered separately via consumable credit packs on every Pro plan. Payment is charged to your Apple ID; subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel anytime in your Apple ID settings. apps.name: Helia: UV Index & Sun Safety
apps.description:
Helia is the honest solar coach. Most sun apps either push you to maximize a tan or just show a raw UV number. Helia does neither. It treats sunlight like what it is — something to enjoy on a budget. The sunburn is the enemy, not the sun.

Helia reads today's UV conditions for your exact location and your skin, then gives you one clear answer: roughly how long you can be in the sun before you should cover up, reapply, or head for shade. That answer — your sunburn budget — is free, forever. We never put safety behind a paywall.

THE FREE SAFETY CORE — for everyone
• Hands-free tracking. Helia can notice when you head out into daylight, meter the session itself, and log it — no timers to start or stop.
• Your sunburn budget. A personalized estimate of how long today's sun may take before your skin has had enough, based on the live UV index and your skin type.
• The Answer. One glance tells you whether it's a cover-up day, a quick-session day, or a stay-out day — no decoding color charts.
• Live UV index + forecast. See the UV climb and fall through the day so you can plan around the harshest hours.
• Cloud- and rain-aware. Helia corrects the UV for the real sky, so an overcast day reads honestly — not as full sun.
• Reapply & cover-up nudges. Gentle reminders to top up sunscreen or step into shade before you've used up your budget.
• Honest by design. Helia rounds toward caution. When in doubt, it tells you to protect.

PRO — the coaching layer (optional)
Pro turns Helia from an instrument into a coach, with guidance grounded in how sunlight affects the body across the day:
• Morning-light timing. Helia suggests when a little outdoor light may help support your daily rhythm and energy — the circadian side of sunlight.
• Your vitamin-D plan. A 12-month, season-aware calendar of what sunlight can realistically contribute at your latitude — including the honest winter months when it can't. The live estimate on Home stays free.
• The Sun Atlas. Every session and every walked Sun Trail on one map — your sun, over time.
• On-device science coach. Ask anything about sun, UV, vitamin D, and your body clock — answered privately on your phone, grounded in cited sources, never the cloud.
• History & trends. Your sun, your budget used, and your patterns over weeks and seasons.

WHY PEOPLE KEEP HELIA INSTALLED
Helia isn't trying to get you a deeper tan or sell you fear. It's a quiet, trustworthy instrument that earns its home-screen spot.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Helia works for you, not on you. Your sun sessions, skin type, and location stay on your device wherever possible and are used to personalize your estimates — not to profile you. Precise location is used only to read your local sun and UV conditions. The coach runs entirely on your device.

A NOTE ON HEALTH
Helia provides general wellness estimates and guidance, not medical advice. Sunburn-budget and vitamin-D figures are estimates based on public UV data and the details you provide — they may differ from reality. Helia does not diagnose, treat, or prevent any condition. For anything concerning your skin or health, please consult a qualified clinician.

Get the free sunburn budget today. Upgrade to Pro when you want the coaching.

Helia Pro is available as an annual or monthly subscription, or a one-time lifetime purchase.

A free trial converts to a paid annual subscription unless cancelled at least 24 hours before it ends; no payment is due during the trial. Manage or cancel anytime in your App Store account settings. apps.name: Embr — Live Streams
apps.description:
Embr is a fast, native Twitch client built for iPhone — not a wrapped web view. Streams open in a real AVPlayer with picture-in-picture, background audio, and instant quality switching. Chat is rendered natively so it stays smooth even in the busiest channels. No bloat, no clutter, just watch and chat.

Browse without an account. Star the channels you love to keep them one tap away, and sign in with Twitch only when you want your follows and to join the conversation.

WATCH
• Native AVPlayer video — live streams, VODs, and clips
• Picture-in-picture and background audio — keep watching while you use other apps
• Audio-only mode for listening with the screen off
• Quality selection, latency display, and landscape fullscreen
• Double-tap to seek, and adjustable playback speed on VODs

BROWSE & DISCOVER
• Favorites — star any channel and see who's live at a glance, no account needed
• Live channels and top categories at a glance
• Search channels and categories instantly
• A Following tab that surfaces who's live (when signed in)
• Rich channel pages with everything you need to dive in

REAL-TIME CHAT
• Live chat over Twitch EventSub — fast and reliable
• Animated emotes from Twitch, 7TV, BetterTTV, and FrankerFaceZ, all merged together
• Badges, cheermotes, mentions, and threaded replies
• Emote autocomplete and recent-message backfill so you're never lost
• Search the chat, report or block messages, and hide users you'd rather not see
• Moderator tools — delete, timeout, and ban — when you're a mod in the channel
• VoiceOver reads every message aloud, emote names included

MADE FOR iPhone
• Light and dark themes, with chat readability and text-scale controls
• Haptics, third-party emote toggles, and a blocked-users list
• Built natively in UIKit for speed and a small footprint
• Full guest browsing — an account is optional

FREE, WITH AN OPTIONAL TIP JAR
Every feature is free for everyone. If Embr becomes how you watch, you can leave a tip in Settings. Tips unlock nothing; they just keep the app going.

Embr is open source.

———

Embr is an independent, third-party app and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, sponsored by, or connected to Twitch Interactive, Inc. "Twitch" and all related names, marks, and logos are trademarks of their respective owners and are used here only to describe what the app connects to. You sign in with your own Twitch account through Twitch's official OAuth; Embr never sees your password. Use of Twitch is subject to Twitch's own Terms of Service.

apps.name: Tailscode: Coding Agent Remote
apps.description:
Send a prompt to Claude Code, opencode or Oh My Pi from your phone, pocket it, and watch the turn finish on your Lock Screen. Approve the risky command, answer the agent's question, read every diff — from anywhere on your own Tailscale network.

WHAT YOU NEED
A Mac or Linux machine on your tailnet (Tailscale is free for personal use) running one of your agents: opencode, Claude Code through the open-source claude-bridge, or Oh My Pi through the open-source omp-bridge. Set-up is three verified steps, and a built-in demo lets you try every screen before you wire anything.

THE TURN, LIVE ON YOUR LOCK SCREEN
• A Live Activity per conversation: what it is doing, for how long, and how many tools it has run.
• An approval request alerts you; a finished turn lingers with its outcome. Tap to land in the exact chat.
• Updates arrive by push while the app is suspended.

A NATIVE TRANSCRIPT, NOT A TERMINAL
• Streaming text written at the model's own speed, with thinking and tool runs folded into readable groups.
• Diffs, commands and their real output inline; syntax-highlighted code with byte-exact copy.
• Allow once, always, or deny — without leaving the chat. Agent questions become tappable cards.
• Queue the next message while a turn runs, edit it before it goes, or stop the turn on the server.
• Every picture the agent hands you, in a gallery you can zoom, save or share.

EVERY MACHINE ON ONE BOARD
• All your servers' conversations in one list, live status first, grouped by project.
• Read the repository before you trust the change: branch, staged, changed, untracked, and the diff of any file.
• Subagents dock inside the turn that spawned them; a compaction is drawn as a seam with what it kept.
• Slash commands from the server's own catalog, per-message model and reasoning effort, forking.

KNOW WHAT IT COSTS
• Every conversation priced, every month totalled across machines — by model, project and tool.
• Plan limits and quotas for Claude, Grok, Ollama Cloud, DeepSeek and more, on Home and in a widget.

YOURS, END TO END
• Point-to-point over your tailnet. No relay servers, no account, no analytics, nobody reading your code.
• Programmatic UIKit, Swift 6, Liquid Glass on iOS 26. Dark mode, Dynamic Type, haptics.
• Open source under GPL-3.0 — the app, the engine, and both bridges.

FREE, WITH AN HONEST PRO
The free app is the complete core: one server, full chat, approvals, attachments, models, forking, and Live Activities. Tailscode Pro is a one-time purchase, no subscription: multiple saved servers, concurrent Live Activities, and a supporter badge.

Tailscode is independent open-source software: not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic, Tailscale Inc., the opencode project or Oh My Pi.

Privacy policy: https://midgarcorp.cc/tailscode/privacy

apps.releaseNotes:
Fixes:
• Conversations no longer stutter when a session changes state. The chat list stopped rebuilding itself behind the conversation on every update, haptic feedback no longer waits on the main thread, and opening the app and a chat is quicker.
• The app writes far less to your phone: a long answer used to rewrite the whole conversation every five seconds as it streamed, which could add up to more than a gigabyte a day.

Changes:
• New chats can walk a machine's folders: a folder browser with a path you can tap back along, a filter that narrows as you type, places to jump to, a star on any folder, a count of the chats already working in each, and “Start here” to open the chat in the folder you are looking at.
• The Usage screen fits on one screen. Your tightest window leads with a one-word verdict, each provider is one compact card with every window's reset beside its name, providers you can still add share one card, and “How this is counted” is one footer. It reflows at the largest text sizes, and its cards now show in light mode.
• The Usage widgets wear each provider's own colour, show a window that has run out as a red mark with “Used up” beside it, show a prepaid balance as one big figure, no longer cut window names short, and on the large size leave out the providers that don't fit instead of running off the tile.
• The image studio puts the picture first: the stage fills the screen, shows the machine's own sketch while the picture is painted with a line along its foot for how far along it is, and Save, Share, Copy, Again, Edit this and Animate this sit directly under the finished picture.
• The machine's pictures are a strip above the brief, newest first, with the render in flight leading it. The decisions are labelled chips whose values are never cut off, and the machine you are painting on is a pill in the bar.
• A third image engine, Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo, paints in eight steps on a machine that has its model; the avoid list and the detail chip stand down for it.
• The video forge draws the machine's sketch of the clip as it renders, with a line for each of its two passes, and keeps your clips on a shelf of posters.
• Video gains Enhance, using the same helper as pictures, a Start from picture (Photos, Files, the camera, the clipboard or the machine's gallery), Continue it on a finished clip, and Animate this on a finished picture.
• Chat is more compact: tool calls, thinking and agent groups rest as one flat line, even a lone tool, a compaction is one line you can tap for its summary, and the space between rows follows what sits on either side of it. Settings › Appearance › Chat density brings the airier layout back.
• A question reads as the heading over its answer: what follows it sits at the paragraph gap instead of the gap between turns.
• The links in an answer are one line instead of a card each — site icons and names that open in place when tapped, and a single address is simply the link — and the pictures an agent made share a row of thumbnails that open the gallery.
• Code blocks no longer leave empty space under their last line.

apps.name: Crucible: Plex Client
apps.description:
Crucible is a fast, native Plex client for iPhone — and a love letter to building iOS apps without a Mac. The whole app is Swift 6 and programmatic UIKit, cross-compiled on Arch Linux and deployed straight to an iPhone over USB. No Xcode, no storyboards, no macOS anywhere in the loop.

EVERYTHING IN ITS PLACE
Home opens on a Resume hero for whatever you were watching, then Continue Watching, Up Next, your week in watch time, and Recently Added. Library grids have filter chips for Unwatched and In Progress, genre and sort, unwatched badges, an A–Z scrubber, and raw folder browsing for unindexed content. Search groups results by type with a Top Result.

A PLAYER THAT RESPECTS YOUR TIME
Skip Intro and Skip Credits straight from Plex markers, Picture-in-Picture with background audio, lock screen and Control Center controls, and Up Next that rolls the next episode as the credits start. Direct play when your device can handle the file, automatic HLS transcoding when it can't.

TAKE IT OFFLINE
Download movies, whole seasons, or single episodes at the quality you pick — Original, High, Medium, Low, or Data Saver. Background transfers keep going when the app is closed and resume after interruptions, downloads stay Wi-Fi-only unless you allow cellular, and a dedicated Downloads tab shows a storage summary, the live queue, and everything ready to watch — with one-tap cleanup of watched titles. A season sheet downloads all, unwatched, or the next three episodes, and can keep the next episodes downloaded as you watch. A Live Activity tracks live progress on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island — a WidgetKit extension compiled and signed on Arch Linux via xtool — while downloads run in the background, auto-resume from where they left off, and ping you when they finish. Offline playback runs through the same player — Skip Intro/Credits, resume, Picture-in-Picture, background audio, and lock screen controls all work with no network.

KNOW YOUR VIEWING
The You tab shows your server and connection status, Watch History grouped by day, and a Year-in-Review dashboard: watch time, streaks, an activity heatmap, top shows, and a shareable card built from your own Plex history.

GO DEEPER
Cast and crew, More Like This recommendations, subtitle and audio track selection, and adjustable playback speed. Hand a title off between your devices and find what you've watched in Spotlight.

OPEN SOURCE, BUILT ON LINUX
Crucible is free and open source under the GPL-3.0 license, with one third-party dependency, GRDB, for the statistics store — everything else is pure Apple frameworks. Read the code, file an issue, or build it yourself.

apps.name: Flaccy
apps.description:
Flaccy is a beautiful player for the music you own. Drop in your FLAC, ALAC, AAC, or MP3 files and get a fast, gorgeous library with gapless playback, synced lyrics, and scrobbling — no streaming subscription, no upload, no account.

YOUR LIBRARY, ORGANIZED
• Import via USB or the Files app — messy folder names and scene releases are identified and cleaned up automatically
• Albums, artists, songs, and playlists with search, sorting, and stunning artwork
• Gapless playback that honors your albums, with queue persistence across launches
• Codec, bit depth, and sample rate shown on every track — see exactly what you're playing

MADE FOR LISTENING
• Synced lyrics with tap-to-seek
• Full playback controls on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
• AirPlay, sleep timer, and a Now Playing screen with ambient artwork backdrops

SCROBBLE EVERYTHING
• Sign in with Last.fm and every play is scrobbled — even offline, with automatic retry
• Loved tracks, listening charts, and artist bios matched to your library
• Year in Music: shareable story cards and a poster of your listening year

PHONE-FREE ON APPLE WATCH
• Sync tracks to your watch and play them offline — no iPhone required
• A true standalone player: gapless playback, shuffle, repeat, and AirPods controls from your wrist
• Storage-smart sync that knows what fits on your watch

REDISCOVER YOUR COLLECTION
• Start a station from any song — Flaccy builds a queue from your own library
• Suggested playlists and similar-artist trails
• Share any track as a universal streaming link — friends open it in their app, you keep your FLACs

HONEST ABOUT AUDIO
The built-in Listening Guide explains what actually reaches your ears — Bluetooth codecs, why lossless can't reach AirPods, when FLAC is worth it, and what blind tests really show. No snake oil.

Flaccy plays FLAC, ALAC, AAC, M4A, MP3, WAV, AIFF, and CAF.
